assumptions: The upstream scale/reference-frame authority supplies an already transformed planet-local camera vector and stable selected planet identity.
limitations: Globe, atmosphere, water, ice and material output is presentation only and never scientific evidence.
The global surface target is a mean-radius geocentric presentation projection, not canonical geodesy or elevation.
No central renderer, camera, scale, selection or scene state is mutated by this provider.

fidelity.validity: Selected planets with supported P5 physical radius and gravity plus an upstream planet-local frame handoff
fidelity.resolution: One selected planet, one bounded approach trace and one global surface target per projection
fidelity.uncertainty: Unsupported or unknown atmosphere/surface material cues remain visually disabled; local terrain/elevation is delegated downstream
